notes.title: Small patch notes for Patch 1.2.0.14762
notes.content:
We fixed some minor issues some of you reported with the last patch, such as:

[list]
[*] The final achievement did not trigger correctly for everyone. That should now be fixed and update once you restart the game
[*] SteamVR launched automatically even if not playing the VR version
[*] the invert camera options in the menu were reset to the default value automatically
[*] font sizes and colors in some menu areas were updated for better readability on SteamDeck
[/list]

If you find more issues and bugs, please continue to report :)

notes.title: Lost Ember has finally arrived on your Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Hi all!

You might have noticed that Lost Ember is finally playable on the Steam Deck! :) The game had a couple of video issues on the Steam Deck, but we've finally found a way to eliminate those soooo:

- Lost Ember is now running on Steam Deck! :LostEmberIcon:
- Alongside the development for both Steam Deck and the VR version, a variety of fixes made their way into the new build. Especially a couple of crashes and collision bugs should no finally be fixed

We love Lost Ember on Steam Deck! Let us know what you think <3 And if you're still experiencing bugs, please continue reporting them!

Cheers,

Your Moonies

notes.title: New Game Mode! - Patch 1.1.0.12935
notes.content:
We have a brand new patch for you and it's a big one! This last patch really demanded quite a bit more attention than we had planned. But let's get right to it:

[list]
[*] NEW FEATURE: we implemented a minimalistic game mode that allows you to turn off all ingame commentary of your spirit companion. This way you can fully concentrate on the visuals and figure out what exactly happened all by yourself. This feature can be toggled on and off at any time during the game, so we urge everyone to try it out!
[*] A lot of fixes: we've been combing through all your reports of crashes or other bugs and managed to fix a whole bunch of them! If you experienced a crash that stopped you from getting through the game, please try it again after this patch!
[*] Controls: invert vertical AND horizontal. Finally!
[*] Controls: hummingbirds now have a way faster default speed (without dashing)
[*] Performance improvements: a lot of areas should run smoother on older systems and loading hitches should be reduced
[*] New language: we added Turkish language support
[*] Fixed some typos and missing translations for various languages
[/list]

[h3]NOTE for Windows 7 users:[/h3] since Microsoft dropped support for Windows 7 a while ago, we cannot build the game with the necessary Win 7 redistributables anymore. Unfortunately this means that (at this point) you cannot benefit from new patches anymore. We are still working on this and are trying to figure out if there is something we can do, but until then we added a new branch to the Lost Ember depot to allow you to play the latest version before this patch. To access this branch, just right-click Lost Ember in your Steam library, go to Properties -> Betas and choose "windows7" from the dropdown list.

And as I always: please continue to report any bugs or issues you have with the new version either here as a comment or in a new thread in the forums. 

Have a great weekend and stay healthy,
your moonies! :)

notes.title: Quick hotfix for the last patch - Patch 1.0.2.12355
notes.content:
After publishing the last patch we realized that there was an issue with customizing controls (or rather resetting to default controls) that could lead to broken movement and camera controls.

That should now be fixed!

notes.title: A bunch of new fixes - Patch 1.0.2.12353
notes.content:
We're keeping busy working on more and more fixes, stability improvements and other changes inspired by your feedback and today we proudly present:

[list]
[*] fixed a crash that could happen when trying to start the game
[*] fixed a crash at the end of chapter 4
[*] fixed some menu crashes
[*] fixed bug that would change the resolution after applying certain video settings
[*] fixed some issues with the "Customize Controls" screen
[*] fixed bug that allowed falling through the floor as an armadillo
[*] improved LODs (and with that the look on lower end hardware) on some objects
[*] fixed some smaller issues with animal AI systems (especially some issues with swarms of birds and fish)
[*] some localization fixes
[*] and some other smaller stuff here and there
[/list]

If you experienced any of the crashes mentioned above, go ahead and see if that still occurs! And if you still see crashes anywhere, old or new, we'd really appreciate it if you would tell us in any channel or as a comment under this post! :) 

Have fun!
Your moonies

notes.title: First patch of the year - Patch 1.0.1.12244
notes.content:
The new year is well underway and of course we've been busy over the last weeks and have a brand new, shiny patch for you! Here's what changed:

[list]
[*] you can now customize the controls! Since this is a new feature and naturally there are a lot of combinations of keys you can set, there might still be some issues when using special keys. If you find anything like that, please reach out! :) 
[*] fixed a crash that some of you reported in connection with video drivers
[*] fixed the (hopefully) last issues with the achievement system! Some of you reported not being able to unlock the very last achievement. This should now be fixed! It should automatically trigger once you start the game, if you have all the other achievements unlocked. If it doesn't, try switching between animals to trigger the achievement check.
[*] optimized loading times and level loading for lower spec PCs
[*] fixed bug that resulted in lower resolutions when changing between fullscreen and windowed mode
[*] fixed some camera issues with the buffalo and sloth
[*] and more minor fixes
[/list]

Also, we decided to leave in the Christmas mode for another few weeks, especially since some of you weren't able to activate it properly! Please try again after this patch and report back if you still can't activate it! 

And as always: please continue sending us your feedback, it is highly appreciated and helps us dramatically to improve the game! :)

Cheers,
your moonies

notes.title: And another one - Patch 1.0.0.12054
notes.content:
And here's the next smaller patch:

[list]
[*] fixed a bug that caused the game to be still running in the background after closing it
[*] fixed a bug that caused the game to be started at a later point when selecting a "Fallen Hero" name before the game start
[*] fixed Chinese localization issues
[/list]

If you experience any other issues, just write them here in the comments or, if it's a critical bug, just open a new thread!

Cheers,
Your moonies :)

notes.title: Collisions and Cameras - Patch 1.0.0.12033
notes.content:
And another small update that fixes some of the most commonly reported bugs!

[list]
[*] when switching out of another animal, the collision checks are way better to avoid getting stuck or become the wolf where it shouldn't be allowed
[*] improved camera clipping issues, especially with the goat
[*] fixed a bug that caused memories to be counted as triggered when they weren't
[*] fixed a UI bug that showed a higher number of collected mushrooms than there actually are
[/list]

I hope these fixes improve the game for those of you who encountered these issues before! And again: please continue sending us your feedback, it is highly appreciated and helps us dramatically!

Cheers,
your moonies

notes.title: A couple of fixes
notes.content:
Thank you very much for your feedback so far! We've been looking into all the issues you reported and managed to fix a bunch of it over the weekend. 

What changed so far:

[list]
[*] seemingly random crashes at various points in the game
[*] some collision and clipping issues that could cause you to be stuck somewhere
[*] the wolf not being able to move after certain actions
[*] some cut off voices 
[*] some localization issues
[*] various other smaller fixes and changes
[/list]

We're still looking into other issues we saw like crashes when starting up the game (if you experience that, try updating your graphics drivers, it seems like it helped some) or other corners you can get stuck in.

Please keep on reporting any issues you have with the game, it's highly appreciated and we're doing our best to fix what we can! 

Your moonies :)

notes.title: Status Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27836832/5dde09ee5cf2b74ba0543e538de9a38bf6ffb7a8.jpg[/img]

Hey guys, 

just wanted to say, we’re still alive and making good progress on the game. Our Beta tier supporters have been testing the Beta for two weeks now. Looks like they’re pretty happy with it too :) Nevertheless there are still a couple of issues to fix and until we’re absolutely sure, we will not set a new date. Don’t worry though, pretty soon we’re going to suddenly and unexpectedly shout a new date out to all channels ;) We’re getting closer every day and the game keeps looking better and better. 

Gamescom
With release being close, Tobias and I went to Gamescom to give interviews with the press to promote Lost Ember. It hurts not being in the office for 3 days, but it’s absolutely vital to Lost Ember’s success, so we went. And it seems like it was worth it. We had back to back interviews. And they all enjoyed the hands-on demo a lot. Fingers crossed they also write about it ;)

Kawaii Japan
Mooooar news: We just found a wonderful partner who is going to handle Japan for us and they will even record Japanese voice over, which is so cool, because I have high hopes for Japan and having them help is probably bringing Lost Ember in front of so many more Japanese eyes. I think Japan might like our Kawaii critters. 

Talk to you soon. We seriously cannot wait to show you what we made.
Thanks for listening <3

Love,
Your moonies
